game_concept: A action puzzle set in Frost Peaks – Basecamp Ridge, the basecamp on a ridge: the mountaineer must handle yetis while practicing strings & dictionaries. Core idea – Phrase Slicer: Slice strings to cut messages into exactly the needed pieces.
theme: Frost Peaks – Basecamp Ridge: the basecamp on a ridge
core_gameplay_loop: In Basecamp Ridge, repeat each round: Slice strings to cut messages into exactly the needed pieces. Each round, a new oxygen tanks challenge appears; solve it to bank points before time drains. Then check the phrase_ok value and advance.
player_objective: Collect 340 points of oxygen tanks by answering each challenge with the right code concept before the clock runs out.
controls: Keyboard: arrow keys move the hero, SPACE performs the main action, ENTER runs the code.
lose_condition: Timer hits 0 with score < 340, or lives reach 0.
learning_alignment: Week 8 – Strings & Dictionaries | Level 7 (applied tier): Phrase Slicer
assets_style: towering pixel-art mountains: glaciers, jagged ice ridges, crisp white and cyan with deep blue shadows; flat Kenney-style sprites; thin howling wind, high strings and ice-crack stings
duplicate_check_notes: Unique combination of primary mechanic 'Phrase Slicer' (Week 8 slot 2), mission type 'Resource Rush', and setting 'Basecamp Ridge'. No other file shares this combination; games sharing the mechanic differ in mission/win condition and setting, and games sharing the setting use a different mechanic.

region.name: Frost Peaks
region.mood: thin howling wind, high strings and ice-crack stings

tutorial: Step 1: Look at the code panel. It shows how phrase_ok changes.
Step 2: Use the controls to apply the code idea against yetis in Basecamp Ridge.
Step 3: Win by meeting the goal: score >= 340 within 48 seconds.
